lines.say: GCSE biology, the basics. Two questions loads of people get wrong.
Where are proteins made in a cell?
Ribosomes. Not the nucleus. The nucleus holds the instructions.
Next. True or false: respiration makes energy.
False. Respiration releases energy. Energy is never made.
